<?php

function solve() {
    $input = trim(fgets(STDIN));
    $parts = explode(' ', $input);
    $n = (int)$parts[0];
    $k = (int)$parts[1];

    $set = [];
    $bool = true;

    for ($i = 1; $i <= $k; $i++) {
        $rest = $n % $i;
        if (!isset($set[$rest])) {
            $set[$rest] = true;
        } else {
            $bool = false;
            break;
        }
    }

    if ($bool) {
        echo "Yes\n";
    } else {
        echo "No\n";
    }
}

solve();

Imp rapidly proposed a guess that they are the remainders of division of a number n by all integers i from 1 to k. Unfortunately, there are too many integers to analyze for Imp.Imp wants you to check whether all these remainders are distinct. Formally, he wants to check, if all , 1 ≤ i ≤ k, are distinct, i. e. there is no such pair (i, j) that:   1 ≤ i < j ≤ k,  , where  is the remainder of division x by y.
